record.name: Funded executed-input rebate
record.summary: Credit a real prefunded rebate against actual successful input paid through a callback router.

units.identity: Callback sender is usually a router; signatures/NFTs do not imply human diversity

definition.help: Callback sender/router receives credits; not an unverified wallet from hookData. Gross actual input includes LP fee. Opposite swaps do not restore consumed sponsor budget. Rates are ppm and caps separate raw-currency amounts per credited callback. End stops new credits; owed credits stay payable and only unused budget refunds.
